responsibility: Implements callgraph cloning mechanics, especially virtual clones and versioned function copies. It creates cloned edges, builds new version declarations and bodies, records parameter and replacement mappings, updates call expressions and clone-tree links, and materializes virtual clones into real functions when bodies are needed. This is the file that turns IPA decisions such as constant propagation, inlining, or signature changes into concrete clone nodes while preserving callgraph consistency.
